verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical, and both have the same faults. The tiny logo sits under the badge at the bottom left, separated from the headline. The body copy is squeezed into a narrow five-line column with ragged breaks ('golden / hour.'). The headline sits on a translucent circle, and the CTA floats with little relationship to the copy. A has the better headline break ('Chase / the Light' keeps the coloured phrase together), but its logo wordmark reads 'SOLST CE' because the I is missing or covered, which damages the brand. B keeps the logo intact but breaks the headline awkwardly as 'Chase the / Light', so the orange phrase is split across lines.
